# Vacancy research: 1006 Jefferson St, Oakland

**APN:** 002 003501200  
**Research date:** 2026-10-15  
**Verdict:** likely_occupied (0.91)

## Assessment

The available evidence supports ongoing residential leasing at this mixed-use building, including an individual unit marked rented and current rental offers by the property manager and on Zillow. It does not show that every apartment is occupied; listed units may be vacant during normal turnover. No reviewed source documents a whole-building vacancy period, so a vacancy start date and duration cannot be determined.

## Evidence and limits

- The manager's own Unit P page calls it available now at $1,395/month on a one-year lease: https://www.crownfortune.com/apartments/1006-jefferson-street-p
- Zillow's building page lists Unit D for rent: https://www.zillow.com/b/1006-jefferson-st-oakland-ca-5Z2mwG/
- SF Bay Rental Co. marks Unit F rented but gives no rental date: https://www.sfbayrentalco.com/property/1006-jefferson-st-unit-f-oakland-2
- Oakland's 2019 enforcement report lists a zoning case concerning a massage business at 1010 Jefferson St, marked Non-Actionable; this is not a vacancy signal for 1006: https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/planning-amp-building/documents/ce/bce-reports/code-enforcement-quarterly-report-inspection-count-q4-april-1-june-30-2019.pdf
- Oakland's 2024 tax roll codes the parcel as a first-floor store with offices and apartment/loft above, confirming mixed use but not occupancy: https://oakland.legistar.com/View.ashx?G=15529D0E-EFE8-4C09-817E-CE554309072E&GUID=E4E0D13F-7635-4B47-B0FA-271A96F9B96C&ID=14301879&M=F

**Duration:** No evidence supports a whole-building vacancy start or duration. Individual vacancies/lease dates are not established by these sources.
